graph_domains.name: Fleet & Infrastructure Renewal (SGR)
graph_domains.note: All five expected sources are connected and profiled; the contract, amendments and project evidence are in the Drive corpus.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No asset, finance or project source connected.

graph_domains.name: Contract Responsibility & Recovery
graph_domains.note: Responsibility assignments, amendments and claim states resolve. Legal liability is out of scope — the graph raises review items, it does not decide them.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No contract register or executed contract connected.

graph_domains.name: Operational Readiness
graph_domains.note: Service requirement, access windows and availability are connected; workforce planning is not, so skills and crews are never tested.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No service-planning or availability source connected.

graph_domains.name: Predictive Asset Failure
graph_domains.note: Telemetry covers buses only and no failure series is censored for assets that have not failed — prediction would not validate out of time.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No telemetry or censored failure history connected.

graph_use_case_templates.name: Fleet & Infrastructure Renewal
graph_use_case_templates.description: One model over asset condition, project delivery, finance, contract responsibility and evidence, so a renewal question resolves once — with the perspective (operator or authority) stated.

graph_metrics.name: Forecast Total Project Cost
graph_metrics.definition: Forecast_Total = [Posted actuals] + [Valid uninvoiced accruals] + [Forecast cost to complete]. Accruals are matched and reversed when invoices arrive; cost to complete excludes work already accrued.

graph_metrics.name: Forecast Cost to Complete
graph_metrics.definition: CTC = [Remaining committed work] + [Expected uncommitted work] + [Contingency held separately]. Never adds the full PO value again.

graph_metrics.name: Forecast Budget Variance
graph_metrics.definition: Variance = [Forecast_Total] − [Current approved budget]. Positive means overrun; the original baseline variance is kept beside it.

graph_metrics.name: Open Commitment
graph_metrics.definition: Open_Commitment = [Ordered] − [Received] − [Cancelled], at the PO line's valuation basis. Unpaid invoices are not future work.

graph_metrics.name: Approved Funding Gap
graph_metrics.definition: Funding_Gap = [Forecast fundable expenditure] − [Applicable approved funding], applying scope, caps and co-funding; uncovered costs labelled separately.

graph_metrics.name: Operator Exposure
graph_metrics.definition: Operator_Exposure = Σ costs borne by Keolis Valmont under validated allocations, with unresolved-exposure scenarios shown separately. Never equal to project cost.

graph_metrics.name: Service Availability Margin
graph_metrics.definition: Margin = [Eligible available vehicles] − [Peak requirement] − [Agreed reserve], by class, location and time; each unavailable vehicle subtracted once.

graph_metrics.name: Failure Frequency
graph_metrics.definition: Failure_Frequency = [Relevant failures] ÷ [Distance] × 100,000, with a consistent failure taxonomy and peer group.

graph_metrics.name: Schedule Variance
graph_metrics.definition: Schedule_Variance = [Current forecast milestone date] − [Approved baseline milestone date], on the working calendar; approved re-baselining identified.

graph_metrics.name: Renewal Backlog
graph_metrics.definition: Renewal_Backlog = validated intervention needs not yet completed, by status (unfunded, approved, in progress, deferred), overlapping options de-duplicated.

graph_metrics.name: Documented Acceptance Completeness
graph_metrics.definition: Completeness = [Verified required acceptance items] ÷ [Applicable required items]. Completeness is not permission to operate.

graph_metrics.name: Project Cash Position
graph_metrics.definition: Cash_Position = [Cash paid] − [Project-related cash received] at a stated cutoff; excludes unpaid expense and uncollected approved recovery.
